title: A Pope Named Leo Takes On AI, 135 Years After Rerum Novarum
dek: Leo XIV's first encyclical reads AI through a line of Catholic thought that runs from Aristotle and Aquinas to Leo XIII's 1891 letter on industrial labor.
body: Leo XIII wrote about factories in 1891. On 15 May 2026, the same date 135 years later, Leo XIV signed Magnifica Humanitas on AI.

panels.label: The Encyclical Argues
panels.text: AI should serve the person and be “disarmed”; humanity flourishes “through” its limits.

panels.label: Transhumanists Argue
panels.text: Humanity should direct its own evolution past biological limits; accelerationists push for unconstrained AI.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides say AI changes what a human life can be; at stake is whether human nature has limits worth keeping.
